# ARC-1 Compact R8.5 interconnect matrix (GENERATED by tools/gen_reports_r85.py from board/r85_board_plan.json)

Every signal net that touches at least two devices, after following series resistors (<= 1 kOhm).
'Inactive state' = the level set by board pulls while all drivers are high-Z/in reset (boot sampling, unpowered FPGA).
Devices: U15 F133, U16 boot NOR, U17 MN820 MISO buffer, U18 LFE5U-45F, U21-U24 SPI0 isolation, U20 DONE delay, U25 PSRAM, J3 MN820, J7 microSD, J1 USB-C, U28/U29 amps (R08 U19 config flash and U26 pull-down switch removed).
